// REQ: LANG-2621 LANG-2622 LANG-2623 LANG-2624
namespace Demo {
    open Microsoft.Quantum.Intrinsic;
    // Bell state
    @EntryPoint()
    operation Bell() : Result[] {
        use (a, b) = (Qubit(), Qubit());
        H(a);
        CNOT(a, b);
        let results = [M(a), M(b)];
        Message($"Results: {results}");
        ResetAll([a, b]);
        return results;
    }
}
